But the hidden tests failed because the features are not implemented. The agent did not even attempt to implement them.

So it's not a budget issue; it's a skill gap: the agent didn't realize it needed to code.

The agent's final message says "All requirements are believed to be met based on the changes made and tests run." But no changes were made. That's a mistake. So cause: skill_gap.

Now, is the solution correct? The agent's attempt does not satisfy any of the requirements because it did not implement them. So solution_correct is false.
